th: อ่านง่ายขึ้น
sub: Readers with low vision, older readers and people who use a screen reader (software that reads a page aloud) need pages built so they can read them.

th: หลังเกิดอุบัติเหตุ
sub: After a crash in Thailand, the police report, the insurer and the rental shop use Thai. The compulsory insurance pays up to ฿30,000 a person for treatment before fault is decided.

th: ทำและลงโฆษณาให้
sub: Shops pay for ads on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or Google to reach people in Thailand, and each platform has its own budget rules, account and report.

en: Listing sheet for a property agency
th: ตารางประกาศสำหรับนายหน้า
sub: An agency's listings change often. A home that is sold or let stays on the list until someone removes it, and callers ask about homes that are gone.

en: AI assistant with your name on it
th: ผู้ช่วย AI ในชื่อของคุณ
sub: Visitors ask the same questions again and again, and a person has to answer each one. An assistant on your site answers from your own pages, under your name.

th: ระบบอัตโนมัติ
sub: A task done by hand week after week takes hours that add up. This service sets one such task to run itself in n8n, Make, Zapier or code.

en: Clean or sort a big file with AI
th: ทำความสะอาดหรือจัดไฟล์ใหญ่ด้วย AI
sub: People have files with thousands of rows to clean, sort or summarise, and AI companies run bulk jobs at half the usual price.

en: One LINE account for many shops
th: ไลน์เดียวหลายร้าน
sub: A shop with its own LINE account has its own inbox and its own plan fee. One LINE Official Account can answer for several shops, hotels or branches, and chats get the replies of the right one.

en: Calendar or fortune calculator for your website
th: ปฏิทินหรือเครื่องคำนวณดวงบนเว็บ
sub: People put a Lanna calendar or a fortune calculator on a site so visitors can look up a day or a reading there. The north keeps its own months and its own good and bad days.

th: พระเครื่อง
sub: Amulets are small sacred objects that people wear for protection or luck. The price of one depends on its maker, age and scarcity, and forgeries are common.

th: ทดสอบแอปบนมือถือคนไทย
sub: People want to know what breaks when Thai speakers use their app on the phones sold in Thailand, before customers find out.

th: แอปมือถือ
sub: A web app installs from the browser and an Android app from a file, so no store takes a registration fee or a share of sales. Either opens and saves with no signal.

th: บทความ
sub: An article that names its sources lets a reader check it, and a website or blog needs its articles written.

th: ผู้ช่วยส่วนตัวในไทย
sub: People who live or run a business in Thailand need a Thai and English speaker to make calls, place orders, pick things up and handle paperwork.

th: เอกสารส่งประกวดรางวัล
sub: A cyber-security award is decided from a written entry, so the entry has to say what the work was and show the evidence.

en: Hot-air balloon or paramotor (motor paraglider) flight
th: บินบอลลูนหรือพารามอเตอร์
sub: Balloons fly in Chiang Mai only from November to February, and paramotors fly at dawn and late afternoon, when the air is calm.

th: เปิดบัญชีธนาคารไทย
sub: People open a Thai account for rent, bills, pay or the ฿800,000 retirement deposit, and banks set their own rules for foreigners.

th: ปาจื้อหรืออี้จิง
sub: People ask for a Bazi chart, which is worked out from the year, month, day and hour of birth, or for an I Ching reading of one question.

th: จองตรวจเลือดหรือตรวจสุขภาพ
sub: People book a blood test or a health check-up in Thailand, and Thai hospitals sell the check-up as a package with a price, a list of tests and an end date.

th: ทำบัญชีไทยและอังกฤษ
sub: People running a business in Thailand want each month's income and costs recorded in Thai for the accountant and in English for themselves.

th: ผู้ช่วยเจ้าสาว
sub: A bride's day has a dress, hair and makeup, fittings, a photographer and a schedule. Someone else books and arranges them.

th: โทรแทนคุณ
sub: People ask for a call in Thai when they need an answer from a shop, clinic, office or landlord and would rather have it written down.

th: โทรออกแทนคุณ
sub: People want a list of names called in Thai or English, to sell something or to book appointments. Each result goes into a sheet.

en: Car, driver or guide for a day
th: รถ คนขับ หรือไกด์หนึ่งวัน
sub: People hire a car and driver to get around the north without driving, or a licensed guide to explain the sights in their own language.

th: ไปเยี่ยมผู้สูงอายุ
sub: People with an older parent in Thailand want to know how the parent is, and a visitor can tell the family what was seen.

th: การ์ตูนสำหรับแคมเปญ
sub: A health, charity or public campaign uses drawn panels to carry its message in pictures.

th: ลงชื่อและเช็กอินอาสาสมัคร
sub: A volunteer programme needs a list of who signed up and who came, and the list can start on the volunteer's phone.

th: อากาศสะอาดในบ้าน
sub: Chiang Mai's air is worst from about February to April, and people want a sensor that shows indoor PM2.5 and a purifier that fits the room.

th: ผู้ช่วยธุรการสำหรับชมรม
sub: A club's mail, receipts and donations land on one volunteer, and the work comes back month after month.

th: เทียบราคาให้
sub: People set quotes side by side before they buy insurance, internet, a car, an appliance, a school place or a hospital package.

th: เนื้อหาเว็บไซต์
sub: A website in Thai and English needs the words for each page written in both languages.

en: Charge AI bots for reading your site
th: เก็บเงินบอท AI
sub: AI companies send bots to read websites, and Cloudflare lets a site owner set a price for each read.

en: Our team for one day, on a hard problem
th: ทีมหนึ่งวันกับโจทย์ยาก
sub: People bring a hard problem with many parts, and a crew of AI agents can work on the parts at the same time.

th: แอดมินตอบแชทภาษาไทย
sub: A shop or office gets chats on LINE, Messenger or email, and needs them answered in Thai and English on working days.

th: โปรแกรมเก็บข้อมูล
sub: People want a data collector when a website or a set of files holds numbers they need in a table, and copying by hand takes too long.

th: หาฤกษ์
sub: People choose a date for a wedding, a move, an opening or a new car. In Thailand an astrologer often picks it from birth dates and a lunar calendar.

th: เมื่อมีคนเสียชีวิตในไทย
sub: When someone dies in Thailand, the family needs the death registered, papers for the embassy, and a funeral home for a cremation or the flight home.

th: สไลด์นำเสนอ
sub: An investor, a buyer or a grant panel looks through your slides before it replies. A pitch deck is that set of slides, in Thai or English.

th: ราคาที่ขยับตามความต้องการ
sub: People who sell rooms, meals or tickets want the price to go up when it is busy and down when it is quiet, as San Francisco does for parking.

en: Directory website for your trade or region
th: สารบบของวงการคุณ
sub: The businesses and makers in a trade or region are spread over many sites; a directory puts them in one list, with sources, a map and a plain-text copy for AI tools.

th: เพื่อนช่วยต่อรอง
sub: People ask for a Thai speaker to bargain or settle with a dealer, a seller, a landlord, a repairer or a neighbour, because the talk is in Thai and money is at stake.

th: แผนที่หรือภาพวาด
sub: People ask for a drawn map or picture when a photograph or a paragraph does not show a place or an idea.

th: นาฬิกาปฏิทินล้านนา
sub: A clock that shows the Lanna day gives a temple, a hotel or a home the northern date at a glance.

th: บ้านพักหรือผู้ดูแลผู้สูงอายุ
sub: Finding a care home or a caregiver takes calls, visits and comparing. Someone else shortlists, visits and compares the homes, or finds a caregiver, interviews with you and hires one.

th: วิ่งธุระ
sub: People ask for an errand to be run when the counter, the queue or the shop is across town and they would rather send someone.

th: ร้าน Etsy หรือ eBay
sub: People sell crafts and other goods to buyers abroad on Etsy or eBay. Each site has its own fees.

th: ชุดจัดงานการกุศล
sub: A fundraiser for a club, school or charity needs a page with the details, QR codes for tickets or a raffle, a list of sponsors and thank-yous. This kit is those four.

th: หน้างานพร้อมขายบัตร
sub: A workshop, concert or festival needs seats paid before the day and a way to let people in.

th: วางแผนจัดงาน
sub: A party, launch, company dinner or retreat is a budget, a venue, food, sound and a running order. Someone else keeps them in order and runs the day.

th: หน้าอัตราแลกเปลี่ยน
sub: People who run a money changer want customers to see today's buy and sell rates before they walk in.

en: Class or workshop, with a translator
th: คลาสหรือเวิร์กช็อปพร้อมล่าม
sub: People book a class to try muay thai, Thai cooking, silver work or weaving, and a translator is there so the teacher is understood.

th: ดูแลเพจ Facebook
sub: A shop's Facebook page needs posts and replies week after week, and the owner is busy with the shop.

en: Your collection easy to find online
th: ทำให้คอลเลกชันค้นเจอ
sub: A search engine reads the description, the credit and the labels of a photo, and a collection without them gives it little to read.

en: Thai form filled in for you
th: กรอกฟอร์มให้
sub: Government and bank forms come in Thai, and people want them filled in with the English written beside the boxes.

en: Web pages in German, Swiss spelling
th: หน้าเว็บภาษาเยอรมัน แบบสวิส
sub: People put a web page into German for guests and buyers, and Swiss spelling writes ss where Germany writes ß.

th: หน้ารับบริจาค
sub: A gift can reach a charity by card, PayPal, Wise or bank transfer, and the fees differ by route. A giving page puts the routes side by side for the donor's country and amount.

en: Grab, LINE MAN or ShopeeFood for your shop
th: Grab LINE MAN ShopeeFood สำหรับร้านของคุณ
sub: Shops list on delivery apps to sell to people who order food at home, and each app has its own sign-up, papers and review time.

th: ทุนและเงินบริจาคก้อนใหญ่
sub: Funders ask for different forms and set different dates. You get applications written to the funder's form, a case for support in English and Thai, and a calendar of funder deadlines.

th: โลโก้และภาพลักษณ์แบรนด์
sub: A name on a sign, a post and a page reads as one business when the logo and colours match.

en: Guide site for your town or hotel
th: เว็บไกด์สำหรับเมืองหรือโรงแรม
sub: A town, a hotel or a guesthouse gives visitors a page of where to go, eat and walk, with a route they follow on their own.

en: Help page with a live map
th: หน้าช่วยเหลือพร้อมแผนที่สด
sub: A tow, roadside or delivery firm gives a person in trouble one page that shows where the firm is and how far, with a help card in three languages.

th: ทำบุญบ้านหรือเปิดร้าน
sub: A house or shop blessing has several parts: monks, an altar, a ceremony master, offerings and a meal that ends by noon. Someone else lines them up.

en: ID.me, VA or SSA sign-in help
th: ช่วยเข้าระบบ ID.me VA SSA
sub: US veterans and their families in Thailand can sign in to VA.gov through ID.me, which asks for identity documents and a video call.

th: หน้าเว็บโต้ตอบหรือเกม
sub: People ask for an interactive page when a subject is hard to explain in text, or when an event or a brand wants a game.

th: ล่าม
sub: People bring an interpreter when the officer, the doctor or the bank speaks a language they do not.

th: บันทึกบทสัมภาษณ์
sub: A maker or an elder knows things that are not written down, and an interview records them with the person's consent.

en: Invoice page for PayPal or Wise
th: หน้าใบแจ้งหนี้ PayPal Wise
sub: A customer abroad needs an invoice they can open and pay online, and PayPal and Wise each take that payment their own way.

th: ทำบัญชีภาษาเขมรและอังกฤษ
sub: People who own a company in Cambodia want each month's income and costs recorded in Khmer for the tax office and in English for themselves.

th: ส่งตรวจห้องแล็บให้
sub: People send a sample to a Thai lab to learn what is in their water, food or material, or how pure a compound is.

th: ปริวรรตใบลานล้านนา
sub: Palm-leaf and folded-paper manuscripts in Tai Tham script, also called Lanna script, come out as text in Thai letters that more people can read.

th: ตรวจคำแปลหน้าเว็บ
sub: People have a Thai or English page read by a second pair of eyes for spelling, grammar and word order before it goes up.

th: แปลภาษาไทใหญ่
sub: People put notices, forms and letters into Shan for readers who use it: an estimated 3.2 million speakers in Shan State.

th: พิธีแต่งงานแบบล้านนา
sub: A Lanna wedding has several parts: monks, the khwan rite, Lanna dress and a running order. Someone else lines them up.

th: คืนโคมแสนดวงที่ลำพูน
sub: In November people go to Wat Phra That Hariphunchai in Lamphun for the lantern lights, and Chiang Mai sets rules on where sky lanterns can fly.

th: รายชื่อลูกค้าเป้าหมาย
sub: Teams that call or write to businesses start from a list: who fits, how to reach them, and where each name came from.

th: รับรองเอกสาร
sub: People need the Ministry of Foreign Affairs seal, or a notary, on a document that another office has asked to see sealed, and someone has to take it to the counter and bring it back.

en: Chat memory for your LINE group
th: ความจำสำหรับกลุ่มไลน์
sub: A person who joins a LINE group later cannot see the chat messages sent before, so the group answers the same questions again.

en: Lucky phone number or car license plate
th: เบอร์หรือทะเบียนมงคล
sub: People ask whether a phone number or a car plate is lucky. Some plate numbers go to auction with starting prices of ฿500,000 or more.

catn: Moving house to or from Thailand
th: ส่งกระเป๋าหรือมอเตอร์ไซค์
sub: People send a suitcase or a scooter to another city so they can travel without it. Couriers, Thailand Post and the State Railway each set their own weight and price.

en: Map of your projects or places
th: แผนที่โครงการของคุณ
sub: A charity with projects in many places can show them on one map. A tap on a place opens its page, with a link to give or to get in touch.

th: แก้ระบบรับชำระเงิน
sub: People look for this when a checkout will not take a payment, a payout is held, or PayPal or Stripe limits an account.

en: Merit (Buddhist good deeds) for someone who died
th: ทำบุญอุทิศผู้ล่วงลับ
sub: People make merit for someone who has died on the 7th, 50th and 100th days, with monks invited to chant and eat.

en: Merit (Buddhist good deeds) made for you
th: ทำบุญแทนคุณ
sub: People have merit made in their name at a wat when they live far away or cannot go, and they get photos or a video.

th: สำเนาสำรองของเว็บ
sub: When a host goes down, the site goes down with it, and visitors see an error page until the host is back.

catn: Moving house to or from Thailand
en: Moving house into or out of Thailand
th: ย้ายบ้านเข้าหรือออกประเทศไทย
sub: People who move house into or out of Thailand deal with movers, freight forwarders, an inventory of the goods and customs papers, some of them in Thai.

th: เครื่องรางเขียนชื่อ
sub: A name charm is a small protective piece with a person's own name written on it. In the north, the yant on such pieces is written in Lan Na script.

th: ตั้งชื่อมงคล
sub: People look for a name for a baby, for themselves, for a shop or for a company. Sellers in Thailand work from the birth date and from numerology.

th: จดหมายข่าว
sub: A newsletter goes to a list, and each issue has to be written and laid out before it is sent.

en: Homes that banks are selling, found for you
th: หาบ้านและที่ดินที่ธนาคารขาย
sub: Banks in Thailand sell homes, condos and land they took over from borrowers, and each bank sets its own way to bid.

th: ร้านค้าออนไลน์
sub: Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop keep a share of each sale. An own shop on your own domain takes PromptPay and cards, and the fees come from the payment provider.

th: สั่งออนไลน์สำหรับคาเฟ่
sub: Customers can order from their phones while they sit or queue, and the order reaches the till the café already uses.

th: เป็นพาร์ทเนอร์ขนส่งของหงส์ดำ
sub: A seller who ships crafts and small parcels out of Thailand needs an agreement with a shipping partner, a product list with tariff codes, and carrier accounts.

th: ไฟล์ลายล้านนา
sub: Lanna and Thai ornament is drawn by hand, and a printer, a laser cutter, a sign maker or a tattoo artist needs it as a file.

th: รับเงินพร้อมเพย์
sub: Sellers on LINE or a web page take PromptPay transfers, and each transfer slip is read by a person unless a machine reads it.

en: Monthly pay list for your team
th: สรุปเงินเดือนทีม
sub: People who pay a team by the job want one list on the 1st of what each person is owed, and a way to pay each one.

en: Pha yant (sacred cloth) drawn for you
th: ผ้ายันต์เขียนให้
sub: A yant is a sacred design. It is tattooed on skin, and it also appears on cloth, on metal amulets and above doorways.

en: Photo proof from the project site
th: หลักฐานรูปจากพื้นที่
sub: A funder or a board asks for proof that work happened, and a photo with a time and a place is proof they can look at.

th: ติดตามราคา
sub: Shops watch competitors' prices and stock to set their own, and opening each page by hand every day takes time.

en: Signs and QR stands to print
th: ป้ายและป้ายคิวอาร์พร้อมพิมพ์
sub: A print shop works from a file, and the file fixes the size, the text and the QR code on the sign.

th: ข้อเสนอหรือแผนธุรกิจ
sub: A buyer, a partner, a bank, an investor or a visa office reads a document before it answers. A proposal or a business plan is that document, in Thai or English.

th: ดูดวง
sub: People ask for a reading of their birth chart. A Thai chart is worked out from the date and time of birth.

th: จัดหาของเช่าให้
sub: People rent a car or scooter for a trip or a stay, and equipment or a venue for an event. Each shop or supplier sets its own price and terms.

th: ค้นคว้าคำถามให้
sub: People bring a question when they need facts with sources in writing and do not have days to look for them.

th: ผู้ช่วยร้านอาหารรายสัปดาห์
sub: Prices on delivery apps and new reviews come in week after week, and an owner who runs a kitchen has little time to read them.

en: Retire in Thailand with our help
th: เกษียณในไทย เราจัดการให้
sub: Retiring in Thailand is a home, a bank account, a phone, a hospital and insurance, each at its own office. This service sets them up in order and leaves you one person to call.

th: ชื่อไทยเป็นอักษรอังกฤษ
sub: A set of Thai names needs one English spelling, and the Royal Institute's system writes the sound of each Thai word, not its letters.

en: Sak yant (sacred tattoo) in a less-visited place
th: พาไปสักยันต์กับอาจารย์ในพื้นที่
sub: To Thais a sak yant carries protection, luck or charm. Visitors who want one from a master in the north have an interpreter beside them.

th: กู้เว็บที่ถูกแฮก
sub: A hacked site can send visitors to spam pages, and Google can put “This site may be hacked” under it in search results.

en: Stop fake emails in your name
th: กันอีเมลปลอมในชื่อคุณ
sub: Fake emails can carry your domain's name in the From line. SPF, DKIM and DMARC are the three records a receiving mail server uses to tell your mail from a fake.

th: แปลป้ายและเมนู
sub: A shop's menu or sign works for the customers and staff who can read its language, and a Thai, English or Burmese version reaches the rest.

th: เว็บไซต์
sub: People want a website in Thai and English, on an address of their own.

th: โพสต์โซเชียล
sub: A business that posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or LINE needs words and a picture for a post.

en: We go with you to a dentist, clinic or specialist
th: พาไปหาหมอฟัน คลินิก หรือแพทย์เฉพาะทาง
sub: People looking for a dentist, clinic or specialist in Chiang Mai want English at the appointment, a price before the visit and a booking that fits their insurance.

th: ตั้งศาลพระภูมิ
sub: People set up a spirit house when they move into a new home or open a shop. A ceremony, usually led by a Brahman priest, invites the spirits to live in it.

th: สัญญาจ้างและสลิปเงินเดือน
sub: An employer taking on one person or a team wants a written contract and a monthly payslip, in Thai for the staff and English for the owner.

en: Market stall page with a QR sign
th: หน้าแผงตลาดพร้อมป้ายคิวอาร์
sub: A market stall meets many people for a few seconds each. A QR sign on the table opens the stall's page on the phone in their hand.

th: เว็บรับจองสำหรับโรงแรม
sub: Booking sites keep a share of each room they sell. On your own booking website, guests book and pay you directly.

en: House or land checked before you buy
th: ตรวจบ้านหรือที่ดินก่อนซื้อ
sub: The paper that comes with land in Thailand records one of three things: ownership, a right of possession, or a permit to use the land. The land office charges its 2% transfer fee on an assessed price, a second number next to the asking price.

en: A place to rent, found for you
th: หาที่พักเช่าให้
sub: Listings sit on portals and in Facebook groups, and a lease can be in Thai. You get a shortlist, up to 5 viewings, the lease read in English and the deposit terms checked.

th: สำรวจถนนด้วยภาพ
sub: People ask for a street or a market to be listed shop by shop: the sign, the name and the place on a map.

th: พิธีสู่ขวัญ
sub: People hold a su khwan to call the khwan, a person's life essence, back after a fright, an illness or a long journey.

th: ซับไตเติลและถอดความ
sub: People want the spoken words of a video in writing, or on the screen as subtitles, in Thai, English or Burmese.

en: Contact card on a QR code
th: นามบัตรบนคิวอาร์
sub: A person hands out a code instead of a card, and whoever scans it gets the name, numbers and links on one page.

th: เรียนภาษาไทย
sub: People learn Thai for daily life and work, and a short course in Thai is one of the studies the ED visa covers.

en: A written plan for a hard problem in Thailand
th: แผนสำหรับเรื่องยากในไทย
sub: People ask for a written plan when a bank, a visa, a property or a death in the family needs steps, offices and papers in the right order.

th: คนไปอยู่ด้วยที่หน้างาน
sub: People ask for someone at their place when a tradesperson, a landlord or a delivery comes and they want a Thai speaker there who knows the price that was agreed.

th: สามวันในภาคเหนือ
sub: People book three days in the north to see Chiang Rai's temples, Doi Tung and the Mekong in one trip, with one car and one guide.

th: ทัวร์ส่วนตัวหนึ่งวัน
sub: People hire a car and a guide for the day to reach the White Temple, Doi Inthanon and other sights that lie hours from town.

th: ถ่ายรูปสินค้า
sub: Customers choose from pictures on Grab, Shopee and shop pages, and each place asks for its own size and background.

en: Plumber, electrician or air-conditioning worker, booked
th: หาช่างประปา ช่างไฟ ช่างแอร์
sub: People look for a plumber, an electrician or an air-con cleaner in Thai, and want the price before the work starts.

th: นับผู้เข้าชม คนและบอท
sub: Site owners want to know how many visits come from people and how many from bots.

th: แปลเอกสาร
sub: People translate passports, contracts and certificates for visas, banks and weddings, and offices set their own rules for the translation they accept.

en: Web page for a wedding, a monk ordination or a memorial
th: หน้าเว็บงานแต่ง บวช หรืองานรำลึก
sub: A wedding, an ordination or a memorial brings people together, and one page can hold the photos, video, times and map.

th: วางแผนเที่ยวและจองให้
sub: In the north the sights lie hours apart by road, and the cool season runs from November to February.

en: Paper forms typed into a spreadsheet
th: พิมพ์ฟอร์มกระดาษ
sub: People hold paper forms and receipts in Thai or English handwriting, and need the names and numbers in a sheet they can sort and add up.

en: Car or motorcycle bought with you
th: ซื้อรถยนต์หรือมอเตอร์ไซค์ไปด้วยกัน
sub: A vehicle bought in Thailand is registered in the buyer's name at the Department of Land Transport. A foreign buyer shows a passport and a residence document or a work permit.

th: ทำโค้ดที่เขียนด้วย AI ให้เสร็จ
sub: People start an app or site with an AI tool (Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor) and want it read through, fixed and published.

th: คลิปสั้น
sub: A business on TikTok, Reels or Shorts needs short vertical videos, and each one has to be cut and finished.

th: บันทึกเสียงภาษาไทย
sub: People need Thai lines spoken for an app, a video or a phone message. Sellers price them by the second, the minute or the word.

th: ดูแลเว็บไซต์
sub: A site needs updates and backups, and someone told when it goes down.

en: Move your domain's settings to Cloudflare
th: ย้ายการตั้งค่าโดเมนไป Cloudflare
sub: People move their domain's DNS to a free Cloudflare account, so the website opens with and without www and an old host can be cancelled.

en: Be found on Google and AI search
th: ตั้งค่า Google และ AI
sub: People ask Google or an AI assistant before they call or visit. The tools list pages they have found and read. This set-up adds the files and labels that help them find and read a site.

en: Licence to use our website in your city
th: เว็บของเรา สำหรับเมืองของคุณ
sub: People in another city or province want one of these sites for their own place.

th: แอปในไลน์ ร้านหรือจอง
sub: Many customers in Thailand are already in LINE. You get your LINE account set up with its menu and replies, and an app inside LINE for bookings, orders or member cards, with no password to remember.

en: Email with your own web address
th: อีเมลชื่อของคุณเอง
sub: People want mail from their own name, like you@yourshop.com, delivered to the inbox they already use.

en: Move your website to a new host
th: ย้ายโฮสติ้ง
sub: People move a site from Wix, WordPress or another host to a new one, and the domain and mail move too.

th: ช่องค้นหาสำหรับเว็บ
sub: A site with many pages needs a way to find one page, and Thai text has no spaces between words.

th: ภาพตัวอย่างลิงก์
sub: When a link is posted on LINE, Facebook, X, Bluesky or Mastodon, the picture and title next to it are what people see.

th: วางแผนงานแต่งงาน
sub: A wedding is a budget, a timeline, vendors and a registration at the district office. Someone else keeps them in order and runs the day.

en: Weather, air quality or events box for your site
th: กล่องอากาศ ฝุ่น หรืองาน
sub: A business in Chiang Mai or Chiang Rai puts the weather, the PM2.5 number or this week's events on its own page, so visitors read them without leaving.

en: Let partners and AI read your WordPress
th: ให้ AI อ่าน WordPress ของคุณ
sub: A site with listings on WordPress gives partners and AI tools a way to pull them as data, so nobody copies pages by hand.
